rows.label: tlk70000138_04_msg0001
rows.name:
Things are getting tense all across
Alst because of this so-called
Heaven's Holy Grail.

rows.label: tlk70000138_04_msg0002
rows.name:
They say Shiya was destroyed, and the
balance of power in Alst looks set to
change all at once.

rows.label: tlk70000138_04_msg0003
rows.name:
When you're a helmsman on a Divine
Beast ship, you hear all kinds of
rumors.

rows.label: tlk70000138_04_msg0004
rows.name:
My dad only cared about inventions.
Before, I thought he could drop
dead for all I cared.

rows.label: tlk70000138_04_msg0005
rows.name:
But I've changed lately. I'm even
starting to think it'd be a good
idea to go check in on him.
